name: River Development Agent Controlled Execution Certification Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED EXECUTION CERTIFICATION FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-285 consumes only the exact DEV-284 controlled execution verification result contract.
DEV-285 denies certification when the DEV-284 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, unverified, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required verification evidence.
DEV-285 creates deterministic certification data only.
DEV-285 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-285 does not retry execution.
DEV-285 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-285 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-285 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-285 preserves predecessor provenance and the complete execution/verification evidence chain.
DEV-285 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-285 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-285 does not modify repository content.
DEV-285 does not delete repository content.
DEV-285 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-285 does not commit.
DEV-285 does not push.
DEV-285 does not deploy.
DEV-285 does not access secrets.
DEV-285 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-285 does not perform network execution.
DEV-285 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit controlled execution seal boundary is required before downstream progression.
